rag.text:
Test: TC-5155 — SPM - Workday - Removing Integration with BP
Priority: High | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-505 Workday
Labels: spm-paulina-tc, teamace, teamresources

Description:
In order to execute this test, first execute Workday Integration [https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|smart-link] 

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
2. Click on Refresh Workday absences
   Expected: Refresh Workday absences button is gray and has a loading icon

In the left corner there’s blue message

'Synchronization with Workday in progress

The synchronization of absences from Workday is currently in progress. We will notify you once it has been completed'

After few seconds, green message is displayed ‘Synchronization with Workday finished’
3. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: 
4. Click on userName to open Resource details page
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: Green Label ‘Workday’ is displayed next to userName

Absences are displayed in Absences tab

+ Add new button is grayed out next to Absences tab
5. Click on userName to open Resource details page
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: Green Label ‘Workday’ is displayed next to userName

Absences are displayed in Absences tab

+ Add new button is grayed out next to Absences tab
6. Hover over Add new in Absences tab and click on it
   Expected: Tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually’ is displayed

Nothing happens after clicking on it
7. Hover over Edit pencil icon  in Absences tab and click on it
   Expected: Tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually’ is displayed

Nothing happens after clicking on it
8. Hover over Delete button in Absences tab and click on it
   Expected: Tooltip ‘Absences are managed automatically by Workday and cannot be modified manually’ is displayed

Nothing happens after clicking on it
9. Navigate to App configuration → Integrations → Workday
   Expected: Workday absences integration tab is displayed

All fields are filled out with data and not editable

‘Save’ button is grayed out

‘Remove integration’ button is active
10. Click on Remove Integration button
   Expected: Following message is displayed:

'Remove the Workday integration?

The absences already synchronized will remain in the app, so none of your data will be lost. However, the integration will be removed, and new data will no longer be synchronized.'

Remove and Cancel button are displayed
11. Click Remove
   Expected: All data is wiped from fields

Fields are blank

Save button is grayed out
12. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
13. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: 'Workday sync column' disappeared
14. Click on userName to open Resource details page
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka
   Expected: Green Label ‘Workday’ disappeared next to userName

Absences are still displayed in Absences tab but add, edit and delete buttons are editable
